name: nexus
description: Nexus — Angular 19 micro frontend platform (bygget oven on Native Federation)

scripts.tools:install: cd nexus-tools && npm install && npm run build && cd ../dev-tools && npm install
scripts.dev:catalog: node dev-tools/switch-local.mjs catalog  8701 && npx -y concurrently -n REMOTE,PROXY -c green,blue "cd ../nexus-example/remote-catalog  && npm start -- --port 8701" "npm run dev:proxy"
scripts.dev:cart: node dev-tools/switch-local.mjs cart     8702 && npx -y concurrently -n REMOTE,PROXY -c green,blue "cd ../nexus-example/remote-cart     && npm start -- --port 8702" "npm run dev:proxy"
scripts.dev:product: node dev-tools/switch-local.mjs product  8703 && npx -y concurrently -n REMOTE,PROXY -c green,blue "cd ../nexus-example/remote-product  && npm start -- --port 8703" "npm run dev:proxy"
scripts.dev:checkout: node dev-tools/switch-local.mjs checkout 8704 && npx -y concurrently -n REMOTE,PROXY -c green,blue "cd ../nexus-example/remote-checkout && npm start -- --port 8704" "npm run dev:proxy"
scripts.dev:account: node dev-tools/switch-local.mjs account  8705 && npx -y concurrently -n REMOTE,PROXY -c green,blue "cd ../nexus-example/remote-account  && npm start -- --port 8705" "npm run dev:proxy"
